plan: Hold all workspace state in a single nested dictionary tree, deep-copied at construction and on export so callers can never alias internal state.

Implement total_word_count and unresolved_markers as recursive folds dispatching on item kind: notes strip [[?id]] markers via regex then count \b\w+\b runs; references contribute declared word_count and unresolved lists; containers sum/union their children.
Render the outline with a depth-tracked depth-first walk: workspace title first, then two spaces per nesting level plus '<kind>: <title>' per item in list order.

Implement move as validate-then-mutate: check string ids, locate item and destination (literal 'workspace' or a section/group), reject non-containers, reject self/descendant destinations via an identity-based containment scan, and range-check the insertion index — all before any mutation, guaranteeing failed moves leave to_data() unchanged.
Perform the mutation as a single delete from the source list and insert/append of the same item object into the destination list, preserving the moved subtree intact.
mechanisms: Deep-copied nested dictionary tree as the single canonical representation
Kind-dispatched recursive fold for word counts and marker collection
Regex marker extraction and marker-stripping before word tokenization
Depth-tracked recursive outline renderer with two-space indentation
Validate-before-mutate move with parent-list lookup, container check, and identity-based descendant containment check
